cat > /tmp/create_chart.py <<'PY'
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib import colors, cm
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
from matplotlib.patches import Patch

source = Path('/app/benchmark/source_data.json')
out = Path('/app/output/result.png')
out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

with source.open() as f:
    data = json.load(f)

supply = pd.DataFrame(data['water_supply_demand']['data'])
fresh = pd.DataFrame(data['per_capita_freshwater']['data'])
gw = pd.DataFrame(data['groundwater_extraction']['data'])
precip = pd.DataFrame(data['precipitation_trends']['data'])

piv = precip.pivot(index='country', columns='decade', values='mean_precip_mm').reset_index()
piv['precip_change_pct'] = (piv['2010s'] - piv['1990s']) / piv['1990s'] * 100
piv['precip_change_mm'] = piv['2010s'] - piv['1990s']

df = supply.merge(fresh, on='country').merge(gw, on='country').merge(piv, on='country')

# Composite stress score for ordering only: high = worse.
def minmax(x):
    x = np.asarray(x, dtype=float)
    if np.nanmax(x) == np.nanmin(x):
        return np.zeros_like(x)
    return (x - np.nanmin(x)) / (np.nanmax(x) - np.nanmin(x))

ratio_risk = minmax(-np.log10(df['supply_demand_ratio']))
fresh_risk = minmax(-np.log10(df['per_capita_m3']))
gw_risk = minmax(np.log10(df['extraction_recharge_ratio']))
precip_risk = minmax(-df['precip_change_pct'])
df['convergence_score'] = 0.34*ratio_risk + 0.24*fresh_risk + 0.28*gw_risk + 0.14*precip_risk

df = df.sort_values(['convergence_score', 'supply_demand_ratio'], ascending=[False, True]).reset_index(drop=True)

# Colors
bg = '#f7f6f1'
text = '#1e2933'
muted = '#5a6772'
threshold = '#2f4858'
orange = '#d95f02'
red = '#b2182b'
blue = '#2166ac'
green = '#1b9e77'
bar_blue = '#3b73b9'
bar_pale = '#c7d9ed'

stress_colors = {
    'Extremely High': '#b2182b',
    'High': '#ef8a62',
    'Medium-High': '#fddbc7',
    'Medium': '#92c5de',
    'Low': '#2166ac',
}

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10), dpi=180, facecolor=bg)
gs = fig.add_gridspec(
    nrows=2, ncols=3,
    height_ratios=[0.12, 0.88],
    width_ratios=[1.25, 1.25, 1.05],
    left=0.08, right=0.965, top=0.925, bottom=0.12,
    wspace=0.10, hspace=0.03
)

# Title area
axt = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :])
axt.axis('off')
axt.text(0, 0.78, 'Water-crisis convergence across 10 countries', fontsize=22, fontweight='bold', color=text, ha='left', va='center')
axt.text(0, 0.33,
         'Countries are ranked by a composite of renewable supply deficit, groundwater overdraft, declining rainfall and low per-capita freshwater (2023 estimates; precipitation change: 1990s→2010s).',
         fontsize=10.5, color=muted, ha='left', va='center')

countries = df['country'].tolist()
y = np.arange(len(df))

# Panel 1: supply-demand ratio, log scale, lollipop/bars
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0], facecolor=bg)
vals = df['supply_demand_ratio']
bar_colors = [stress_colors[s] for s in df['stress_class']]
lefts = np.minimum(vals, 1.0)
widths = np.abs(vals - 1.0)
# draw from threshold to value, direction explicit
for yi, val, col in zip(y, vals, bar_colors):
    ax1.plot([1, val], [yi, yi], color=col, lw=8, solid_capstyle='round', alpha=0.95, zorder=2)
    ax1.scatter([val], [yi], s=72, color=col, edgecolor='white', linewidth=1.0, zorder=3)
    label_x = val * (0.93 if val < 1 else 1.06)
    ha = 'right' if val < 1 else 'left'
    ax1.text(label_x, yi, f'{val:.2f}×', va='center', ha=ha, fontsize=9, color=text, fontweight='bold')
ax1.axvline(1, color=threshold, lw=1.5, ls='--', zorder=1)
ax1.text(1.02, -0.75, 'demand = supply', fontsize=8.5, color=threshold, ha='left')
ax1.set_xscale('log')
ax1.set_xlim(0.25, 7.5)
ax1.set_yticks(y)
ax1.set_yticklabels(countries, fontsize=10.5, color=text)
ax1.invert_yaxis()
ax1.set_xlabel('Renewable supply ÷ total withdrawal (ratio, log scale)', fontsize=9.5, color=text, labelpad=10)
ax1.set_title('Supply-demand imbalance', fontsize=12.5, fontweight='bold', color=text, loc='left', pad=10)
ax1.grid(axis='x', color='#d8d3c7', lw=0.7, alpha=0.8)
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', labelsize=8.5, colors=muted)
ax1.tick_params(axis='y', length=0)
ax1.set_xticks([0.3, 0.5, 1, 2, 4, 6])
ax1.set_xticklabels(['0.3', '0.5', '1', '2', '4', '6'])
for spine in ax1.spines.values():
    spine.set_visible(False)

# Panel 2: per-capita freshwater, log bars
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1], facecolor=bg, sharey=ax1)
fvals = df['per_capita_m3']
# color water scarce below 1000 and progressively blue above
norm_f = colors.LogNorm(vmin=80, vmax=90000)
cmap_f = colors.LinearSegmentedColormap.from_list('fresh', ['#b2182b', '#f4a582', '#d1e5f0', '#2166ac'])
for yi, val in zip(y, fvals):
    col = '#b2182b' if val < 1000 else cmap_f(norm_f(val))
    ax2.plot([80, val], [yi, yi], color=col, lw=8, solid_capstyle='round', alpha=0.95, zorder=2)
    ax2.scatter([val], [yi], s=72, color=col, edgecolor='white', linewidth=1, zorder=3)
    ax2.text(val*1.08, yi, f'{val:,.0f}', va='center', ha='left', fontsize=8.7, color=text, fontweight='bold')
ax2.axvline(1000, color=threshold, lw=1.5, ls='--')
ax2.text(1050, -0.75, 'scarcity threshold\n1,000 m³/person/yr', fontsize=8.2, color=threshold, ha='left', linespacing=1.05)
ax2.set_xscale('log')
ax2.set_xlim(70, 130000)
ax2.set_xlabel('Renewable freshwater per capita (m³/person/year, log scale)', fontsize=9.5, color=text, labelpad=10)
ax2.set_title('Orders-of-magnitude freshwater contrast', fontsize=12.5, fontweight='bold', color=text, loc='left', pad=10)
ax2.tick_params(axis='y', left=False, labelleft=False)
ax2.tick_params(axis='x', labelsize=8.5, colors=muted)
ax2.grid(axis='x', color='#d8d3c7', lw=0.7, alpha=0.8)
ax2.set_xticks([100, 1000, 10000, 80000])
ax2.set_xticklabels(['100', '1k', '10k', '80k'])
for spine in ax2.spines.values():
    spine.set_visible(False)

# Panel 3: convergence glyphs for groundwater + precipitation trend
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2], facecolor=bg, sharey=ax1)
gvals = df['extraction_recharge_ratio']
pchange = df['precip_change_pct']
# bubble size is groundwater extraction/recharge ratio; red edge when overdraft >1
sizes = 120 + (np.sqrt(gvals) / np.sqrt(gvals.max())) * 1600
bubble_colors = [red if v > 1 else '#9ecae1' for v in gvals]
edge_colors = ['#7f0000' if v > 1 else '#3b73b9' for v in gvals]
ax3.scatter(np.zeros(len(df)), y, s=sizes, c=bubble_colors, edgecolors=edge_colors, linewidths=1.4, alpha=0.88, zorder=3)
for yi, gv, pc in zip(y, gvals, pchange):
    ax3.text(0, yi, f'{gv:.2f}×', ha='center', va='center', fontsize=8.3, fontweight='bold', color='white' if gv > 1 else text, zorder=4)
    arrow = '↓' if pc < 0 else '↑'
    col = red if pc < 0 else green
    ax3.text(1.02, yi, f'{arrow} {pc:+.1f}%', ha='left', va='center', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold', color=col)
ax3.axvline(0.55, color='#d8d3c7', lw=1)
ax3.text(0, -0.92, 'Groundwater\nextraction ÷ recharge', ha='center', va='top', fontsize=9.2, color=text, fontweight='bold')
ax3.text(1.02, -0.92, 'Precipitation\nchange', ha='left', va='top', fontsize=9.2, color=text, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Overdraft alarm + rainfall trajectory', fontsize=12.5, fontweight='bold', color=text, loc='left', pad=10)
ax3.set_xlim(-0.65, 2.25)
ax3.set_xticks([])
ax3.tick_params(axis='y', left=False, labelleft=False)
for spine in ax3.spines.values():
    spine.set_visible(False)

# Row separators across all panels
for ax in [ax1, ax2, ax3]:
    for yy in np.arange(-0.5, len(df), 1):
        ax.axhline(yy, color='#e4dfd3', lw=0.6, zorder=0)

# Legends
stress_handles = [Patch(facecolor=stress_colors[k], edgecolor='none', label=k) for k in ['Extremely High','High','Medium-High','Medium','Low']]
legend1 = fig.legend(handles=stress_handles, title='Stress class', ncol=5, frameon=False,
                     bbox_to_anchor=(0.08, 0.055), loc='lower left', fontsize=8.7, title_fontsize=9.5,
                     handlelength=1.4, columnspacing=1.15)

legend_handles = [
    Line2D([0], [0], color=threshold, ls='--', lw=1.5, label='Threshold: supply=demand or 1,000 m³/person/yr'),
    Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='none', markerfacecolor=red, markeredgecolor='#7f0000', markersize=10, label='Groundwater overdraft >1.0×'),
    Line2D([0], [0], marker='$↓$', color=red, linestyle='None', markersize=12, label='Declining rainfall (1990s→2010s)'),
    Line2D([0], [0], marker='$↑$', color=green, linestyle='None', markersize=12, label='Increasing rainfall (1990s→2010s)'),
]
fig.legend(handles=legend_handles, ncol=4, frameon=False, bbox_to_anchor=(0.965, 0.055), loc='lower right',
           fontsize=8.5, handletextpad=0.6, columnspacing=1.05)

fig.text(0.08, 0.028,
         'Source data: water_supply_demand, per_capita_freshwater, groundwater_extraction, precipitation_trends. Bubble area scales with extraction-to-recharge ratio; countries sorted by convergence risk score computed from shown indicators.',
         fontsize=8.2, color=muted, ha='left')

plt.savefig(out, dpi=180, facecolor=bg, bbox_inches='tight')
print(out)

    rows[c]['precip_change_mm']=p['2010s']-p['1990s']

def minmax(vals):
    mn=min(vals); mx=max(vals)
    return [(v-mn)/(mx-mn) if mx!=mn else 0 for v in vals]

fresh_risk=minmax([-math.log10(rows[c]['per_capita_m3']) for c in cs])
gw_risk=minmax([math.log10(rows[c]['extraction_recharge_ratio']) for c in cs])
precip_risk=minmax([-rows[c]['precip_change_pct'] for c in cs])
for i,c in enumerate(cs):
    rows[c]['score']=0.34*ratio_risk[i]+0.24*fresh_risk[i]+0.28*gw_risk[i]+0.14*precip_risk[i]
